meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会当 oh-my-opencode 的发布经理:拿到 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号后,触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,轮询等待,再逐项核验 npm 包、GitHub release 和 Discord 公告等发布产物。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release” 等关键词,或要求把 oh-my-opencode 发新版本时触发。没给出版本选择器(patch、minor、major 或具体版本号)时它会先停下来询问。

say.note: 触发发布工作流并核验产物
按这个明确版本号发布

say.text: 这次发布记得发 Discord 公告
say.note: 发布说明定稿后投递公告

howto.what_en: Claude acts as release manager for oh-my-opencode: given patch/minor/major or an explicit semver it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, waits, then verifies npm packages, the GitHub release and the Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Fires when you mention “publish”, “release” or “deploy”, or ask to ship a new oh-my-opencode version. With no release selector (patch, minor, major or an explicit semver) it stops and asks.

say_en.text: Publish oh-my-opencode with a patch bump
say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and verifies artifacts

say_en.text: Make sure this release posts the Discord announcement
say_en.note: Announcement is sent after release notes
